en: The image shows a black-and-white vintage postcard featuring a large domed cathedral with two towers. The postcard contains text in both Greek and French at the top, reading 'Ενθυμιον Θεσσαλονίκης' and 'Eglise Metropole à Salonique' respectively, indicating the subject is a church in Thessaloniki, Greece. The foreground has many trees, and surrounding buildings are visible. A URL, www.elia.org.gr, appears at the bottom, likely from the image provider.
